title: Strict Mode
desc: Prevents any modification of blocking settings for the defined duration.
r1: Deletion of blocked domains or keywords is impossible
r2: Modification or deletion of existing profiles is blocked
r3: Adding sites to the whitelist is disabled
osDesc: To prevent uninstalling the extension, you can force it via your OS enterprise policy.
politicDetails: The ExtensionInstallForcelist policy in Chrome disables the 'Remove' button on the extensions page. The extension becomes impossible to uninstall from the Chrome interface.
openCmd: Open Command Prompt as an administrator
winBlockAll: Blocks uninstallation of all extensions (displays "Managed by your organization")
winLockExt: Keeps this specific extension in normal mode (stays installed, not reinstalled)
addExt: Adds the extension to the force list
restartBrowser: Restart your browser — the ‘Delete’ button will be greyed out ✓
dblCkick: Double-click the file to install it via System Preferences → Profiles
macUndo: To undo: System Preferences → Profiles → select the profile → button
warningUndoInstructions: These commands require administrator rights on your computer. To remove the protection, you will need to reverse the process. Make a note of the removal commands somewhere outside the browser.
willDeactivate: Will deactivate automatically when the timer expires.
onceActivated: Once activated, strict mode : cannot be cancelled until the timer has expired.
tipsDesc: Practical strategies to stop yourself from finding workarounds.
tip1Desc: Let a friend or colleague know you've activated Strict Mode. Social accountability beats willpower every time.
tip2Desc: Strict Mode blocks sites in Chrome, but not tabs already open. Close everything unrelated to your task before activating.
tip3Title: Write down what you will do instead
tip3Desc: Before activating, write 3 specific tasks you will work on. An empty agenda is the enemy of focus.
tip4Title: Remember: the timer will run out
tip4Desc: The discomfort is temporary. The work you do during this time is permanent.
tipsBanner: People who set up external accountability are 3× more likely to follow through than those who rely on motivation alone.
